description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - The Electricity (Procurement) Rules No. 02 of 2016 that applies to the Procurement of Electricity by Transmission Licensee
reasoning: This gazette contains rules made by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009. It establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for electricity procurement processes, including technical specifications, tariff structures, and procedural guidelines. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
